name: Blessing

{derived:Caraboo's Blessing} is a Buff Card with Arithmetica Cost 1 that has {Retain}, {Prepare}, and {Exhaust}.
When played, gain a {Gift} with a {Price} and 1 stack of {Offering}. There are 3 types of {derived:Caraboo's Blessing}:
"Instant {derived:Caraboo's Blessing}": Prevents {derived:Missed Chance}.
"Lavish {derived:Caraboo's Blessing}": Prevents {derived:Gilded Words}.
"Tender {derived:Caraboo's Blessing}": Prevents {derived:Veiled Malice}.
